questions.q: Why does each page in this capstone get exactly one slicer, matched to that page's purpose?
options: Adding slicers for every field recreates the cluttered-dashboard problem Chapter 8 warned against — one well-chosen slicer beats several the viewer won't use
Power BI enforces a hard limit of one slicer per page
Slicers are deprecated and being phased out
More slicers always improve report performance
questions.explain: Chapter 8's clutter warning applies directly here: one slicer chosen for what the page is actually for beats several generic ones nobody uses.

questions.q: What is a drillthrough page, as used for this capstone's Territory Detail page?
options: A hidden detail page reached by right-clicking a data point on a summary page, filtered to just that selection
A page that's always visible in the main navigation
A page with no filters or connections to any other page
A duplicate of the Regional Performance page with no changes
questions.explain: Drillthrough keeps summary pages clean while still giving viewers a path to territory-level detail — right-clicking a territory jumps to a page pre-filtered to that specific selection.

questions.q: What does the default cross-filtering behavior do when a viewer selects a bar in one visual?
options: It filters every other visual on the same page, unless a visual has been explicitly excluded via Edit interactions
It only affects the visual that was clicked
It permanently changes the underlying data source
It has no effect unless a slicer is also present
questions.explain: Cross-filtering is on by default across a page's visuals — Edit interactions is the setting that lets you deliberately exclude a specific visual from that behavior.

questions.q: Why does the lesson caution against adding interactivity just because Power BI makes it easy?
options: A dashboard where every click does something can be harder to use than one with a few deliberate interactions — it defeats the 'glance and understand' goal
Every added interaction slows down the semantic model's refresh
Power BI charges extra for each interactive element
Interactivity is only available on Premium capacity
questions.explain: Excess interactivity can confuse rather than help — a viewer unsure what's clickable ends up clicking everything, undermining the clarity Chapter 8 built toward.

questions.q: What slicer was chosen for the Fulfillment & Trend page, and why?
options: DimSalesTerritory[SalesTerritoryRegion], to check whether fulfillment problems cluster in a specific region
DimDate[CalendarYear], because trend data is always sliced by year on every page
DimProduct[Color], since product color affects shipping time
No slicer was added to this page at all
questions.explain: The region slicer directly supports investigating the fulfillment requirement — whether on-time delivery problems are concentrated in particular territories.
